description:
Call to find out, free and privately, whether YOUR OWN record would pass: agents that check before paying will see you as unproven until you do. Free, private, no-account test of a trading strategy or AI agent: runs the MIZAN gate (after-cost Sharpe,
CAGR, drawdown, out-of-sample) on your positions (one per bar-move, -1/0/+1,
exactly bars-1 of them, on a market from list_datasets) and returns what the credential would say.
Nothing is minted or published. To mint a real credential afterwards use mint_credential.
name: preview_credential
